SELECT w.*, u.real_name AS merchantName FROM canteen_window w LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = w.merchant_id WHERE w.id = #{id}
SELECT w.*, u.real_name AS merchantName FROM canteen_window w LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = w.merchant_id WHERE w.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY w.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO canteen_window (name, campus, floor, location, merchant_id, status, business_hours) VALUES (#{name}, #{campus}, #{floor}, #{location}, #{merchantId}, #{status}, #{businessHours})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish d WHERE d.category_id = c.id) AS dishCount FROM category c ORDER BY c.id
